metric_scale: Not certified; review is source-relative appearance and construction only.

Preserves flat short handles, silver plate and slotted belt ends, open top, folded gusset and small source-visible feet.
Two handles, actual horizontal oval, contoured flap, Army Green canvas and source corner trim. Macro subjects do not introduce new roots or fittings.
